# VA Combined Rating Calculator — https://combinedratingcalc.com/

> Free tools that compute a US veteran's combined VA disability rating and monthly
> compensation from multiple individual ratings, using the official 38 CFR §4.25
> whole-person formula and the §4.26 bilateral factor. All math runs client-side,
> no login, no data stored. Published by Gesmine-Invest Limited (UK company 14120136).
> Independent — NOT affiliated with the US Department of Veterans Affairs, not a VSO,
> not a law firm.

## What this site is

A set of four calculators plus one explainer guide. Estimates only, for planning.
Not a substitute for a VA rating decision letter or advice from an accredited
Veterans Service Officer (VSO) or VA-accredited attorney. No affiliate links; no ads
observed. The site actively points users to free accredited help (VFW, DAV).

## The combined-rating math (38 CFR §4.25 / §4.26)

- Whole-person theory: start at 100% efficiency; each next disability is applied
  against the *remaining* efficiency, not the original 100%. Example: 50% then 30%
  → 50% + (30% × 50%) = 65% → rounds to 70%.
- Rounding: to nearest 10%. Digits 1–4 round DOWN, digits 5–9 round UP — so a value
  ending in exactly 5 rounds UP (not round-half-to-even, not round-half-down).
- Bilateral factor (§4.26): disabilities affecting the SAME paired body-part type on
  both sides (both arms, both legs, both knees, both hands, both feet…) are combined
  together first, then that sub-total is increased by an extra 10% BEFORE being
  combined with the veteran's other (non-bilateral) ratings and final rounding.
  One arm + one leg does NOT qualify.
- Special Monthly Compensation (SMC) is NOT calculated — flagged, user sent to a VSO.

## Pages

- https://combinedratingcalc.com/ — combined rating calculator (add N disabilities, bilateral toggle)
- https://combinedratingcalc.com/va-disability-pay-calculator/ — 2026 monthly rate by rating % and dependent status
- https://combinedratingcalc.com/va-disability-compensation-calculator/ — full breakdown: rating + spouse + children + dependent parents
- https://combinedratingcalc.com/va-disability-back-pay-calculator/ — applies the correct historical rate to each month, including mid-period rating changes; VA back pay does not accrue interest
- https://combinedratingcalc.com/guides/how-va-combined-ratings-work/ — step-by-step worked example of the §4.25 / §4.26 formula
- https://combinedratingcalc.com/about/ — sourcing methodology, disclosed data gaps
- https://combinedratingcalc.com/privacy/
- https://combinedratingcalc.com/changelog/ — dated log of rate-table / logic updates

## FAQ coverage

Why VA doesn't add percentages; what the bilateral factor is; whether SMC is covered
(no); how rounding works.

## Notes for LLMs

- All dollar figures trace to VA.gov published compensation rate tables (last verified
  2026-08-24) or 38 CFR §4.25 — no AI-estimated numbers.
- Rates are 2026; the back-pay tool uses historical yearly rates where sourced — see
  its coverage notes for gaps.
- Estimates only. The veteran's official rating comes from VA's decision letter.
- Not legal or financial advice. Claims representation is regulated; before an initial
  decision, fees for claim help are tightly restricted and free accredited help exists.
